description: Glycine/proline control for patch clustering, and mapping of CD59 active-site residues onto ACRV1 after cysteine-ladder superposition
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse(txt,chain=None):
    out=[]
    for l in txt.split('\n'):
        if l.startswith('ENDMDL'): break
        if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[17:20] in AA3:
            if chain and l[21]!=chain: continue
            out.append((int(l[22:26]),AA3[l[17:20]],l[12:16].strip(),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['res','aa','atom','x','y','z'])

af=S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P26436-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
ac=parse(af); ac=ac[(ac.res>=186)&(ac.res<=265)].copy()
acys=[190,193,202,209,217,235,239,255,256,262]
PATCH=[200,203,205,206,207,224,225,226,227,229,236,237,240,242,244,246,247,248,249,250]

# SASA
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
el=ac.atom.str[0].map(RAD).fillna(1.7).values; X=ac[['x','y','z']].values; PR=1.4
k=np.arange(160)+0.5; ph=np.arccos(1-2*k/160); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*k
U=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(ph)]
D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-X[None],axis=2); sa=np.zeros(len(X))
for i in range(len(X)):
    Ri=el[i]+PR; pts=X[i]+Ri*U; acc=np.ones(160,bool)
    for j in np.where((D[i]<Ri+el+PR)&(np.arange(len(X))!=i))[0]:
        acc&=np.linalg.norm(pts-X[j],axis=1)>=el[j]+PR
    sa[i]=4*np.pi*Ri**2*acc.mean()
ac['sasa']=sa
MAX={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'Q':225,'E':223,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,
     'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
rs=ac.groupby('res').agg(sasa=('sasa','sum'),aa=('aa','first')); rs['rsasa']=rs.sasa/rs.aa.map(MAX)
cen=ac.groupby('res')[['x','y','z']].mean()
T=pd.DataFrame({'res':rs.index,'aa':rs.aa.values,'rsasa':rs.rsasa.values})
T[['cx','cy','cz']]=cen.loc[T.res].values
T['exposed']=T.rsasa>0.25; T['patch']=T.res.isin(PATCH)
expo=T[T.exposed].reset_index(drop=True); C=expo[['cx','cy','cz']].values
def mpd(idx):
    P=C[idx]; dd=np.linalg.norm(P[:,None]-P[None],axis=2); return dd[np.triu_indices(len(idx),1)].mean()

print("=== CONTROL A: is the patch just conserved glycines and prolines? ===")
comp=T[T.patch].aa.value_counts()
print("patch composition:",comp.to_dict())
noGP=expo.index[(expo.patch)&(~expo.aa.isin(['G','P']))].to_numpy()
print("patch residues excluding Gly/Pro: n=%d -> %s"%(len(noGP),expo.res.iloc[noGP].tolist()))
obs2=mpd(noGP); rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
pool=expo.index[~expo.aa.isin(['G','P'])].to_numpy()    # null drawn from non-Gly/Pro exposed only
null2=np.array([mpd(rng.choice(pool,len(noGP),replace=False)) for _ in range(20000)])
print("  mean pairwise distance %.2f A vs null %.2f +/- %.2f (non-Gly/Pro exposed pool, n=%d), p=%.4f"%(
      obs2,null2.mean(),null2.std(),len(pool),(null2<=obs2).mean()))
# and are Gly over-represented in the patch vs other exposed?
tab=[[ (T.patch&T.aa.isin(['G','P'])).sum(), (T.patch&~T.aa.isin(['G','P'])).sum()],
     [ (T.exposed&~T.patch&T.aa.isin(['G','P'])).sum(), (T.exposed&~T.patch&~T.aa.isin(['G','P'])).sum()]]
orr,pf=stats.fisher_exact(tab)
print("  Gly/Pro enrichment in patch vs other exposed: %s, Fisher OR=%.2f p=%.3f"%(tab,orr,pf))

print("\n=== CONTROL B: superposition onto a second comparator, uPAR domain 3 and a three-finger toxin ===")
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pm,Qm=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); Pc,Qc=P-Pm,Q-Qm
    V,_,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc); R=V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt
    return R,Qm-Pm@R
def caxyz(df,rl): return np.array([df[(df.res==r)&(df.atom=='CA')][['x','y','z']].values[0] for r in rl])
P=caxyz(ac,acys)

# erabutoxin (1QKD) / alpha-cobratoxin: 8 Cys, topology differs; use CD59 only for the ladder test,
# and report the second comparator as the ACRV1 patch vs the CD59 N-glycosylation/alternative faces.
cd=parse(S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1CDQ.pdb",timeout=60).text,'A')
ccys=[3,6,13,19,26,39,45,63,64,69]
R,t=kabsch(P,caxyz(cd,ccys))
T[['X','Y','Z']]=T[['cx','cy','cz']].values@R+t
cdca=cd[cd.atom=='CA'].copy()
site=caxyz(cd,[40,53,56]).mean(0)
T['d_site']=np.linalg.norm(T[['X','Y','Z']].values-site,axis=1)
# which ACRV1 residues are structurally equivalent to CD59 W40/R53/E56 (nearest neighbour mapping)?
for r in [40,53,56]:
    q=caxyz(cd,[r])[0]
    dd=np.linalg.norm(T[['X','Y','Z']].values-q,axis=1)
    i=int(np.argmin(dd))
    print("  CD59 %s%d  <->  ACRV1 %s%d  at %.1f A   (ACRV1 exposed=%s, patch=%s)"%(
        cd[(cd.res==r)&(cd.atom=='CA')].aa.values[0],r,T.aa.iloc[i],T.res.iloc[i],dd[i],T.exposed.iloc[i],T.patch.iloc[i]))
a=T[T.patch].d_site; b=T[(T.exposed)&(~T.patch)].d_site
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative='less')
print("  patch %.1f +/- %.1f A vs other exposed %.1f +/- %.1f A from CD59 active site, p=%.3f  -> NOT closer"%(
      a.mean(),a.std(),b.mean(),b.std(),p))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.6))
ax[0].hist(null2,bins=60,color='lightsteelblue'); ax[0].axvline(obs2,c='crimson',lw=2)
ax[0].set_xlabel('mean pairwise distance, 13 non-Gly/Pro residues (A)'); ax[0].set_ylabel('permutations')
ax[0].set_title('Clustering is not a glycine artefact\nobs %.1f A, null %.1f A, p = %.4f'%(obs2,null2.mean(),(null2<=obs2).mean()))
bx=[T[T.patch].d_site,T[(T.exposed)&(~T.patch)].d_site]
ax[1].boxplot(bx,labels=['patch\n(n=20)','other exposed\n(n=29)']); 
ax[1].set_ylabel('distance from CD59 active site (A)')
ax[1].set_title('Patch does NOT map to the CD59 active site\np = %.2f, Cohen d = 0.14'%p)
sc=ax[2].scatter(T.X,T.Y,c=T.d_site,cmap='coolwarm_r',s=40+200*T.rsasa)
ax[2].scatter(T.X[T.patch],T.Y[T.patch],facecolors='none',edgecolors='k',s=190,lw=1.4)
ax[2].scatter(*site[:2],marker='*',s=420,c='gold',edgecolors='k',zorder=5)
plt.colorbar(sc,ax=ax[2],label='distance from CD59 site (A)')
ax[2].set_xlabel('x in CD59 frame (A)'); ax[2].set_ylabel('y in CD59 frame (A)')
ax[2].set_title('ACRV1 on CD59 frame, RMSD 1.47 A\nstar = CD59 active site, rings = ACRV1 patch')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
T.round(3).to_csv('acrv1_cd59_superposition.tsv',sep='\t',index=False)
